summary: TXNM Energy filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 notifying holders that its 5.75% Junior Subordinated Convertible Notes due 2054 are convertible during the Fourth Quarter 2026 Conversion Period, from October 1 through December 31, 2026. The trigger was the common stock trading at or above 130% of the $44.32 conversion price for at least 20 of 30 consecutive trading days ending September 30, 2026. Conversion rate is 22.5654 shares per $1,000 principal. Upon conversion, TXNM delivers an equal principal amount of new 5.75% non-convertible junior subordinated notes due 2054 plus any excess value in stock, with no cash consideration. This is a routine convertible note conversion notice, not a special situation.
